action: Siemens advises operators of Industrial Edge Management Pro or Virtual to shut down instances or disable internet connectivity until a fix is available; watch SSA-272816 for the fix Siemens says it is preparing.
exec: Siemens lists all versions of its Industrial Edge Management Pro and Virtual products as affected by the Java4Shell flaw, with no fix yet.
plain: Siemens says its Industrial Edge Management Pro and Virtual products are affected by the Java flaw called Java4Shell. No fix exists yet; Siemens advises cutting direct internet access.
products: Siemens Industrial Edge Management Pro V1
Siemens Industrial Edge Management Pro V2

key_findings: Siemens advisory SSA-272816 V1.0, published 2026-11-18, covers CVE-2026-114938 (Java4Shell) in Industrial Edge Management Pro V1, Pro V2 and Virtual: all versions affected, currently no fix available.
CVSS v3.1 base score 8.1; Siemens says it is preparing fixes.
The advisory names no exploitation in the wild and no public proof of concept.
recommendations: Siemens calls shutting down instances or disabling internet connectivity the most effective immediate measure.

sources.name: Siemens ProductCERT SSA-272816: Java4Shell Vulnerability in Industrial Edge

summary: Siemens published advisory SSA-272816 on 18 November: all versions of Industrial Edge Management Pro V1, Pro V2 and Management Virtual are affected by the Java4Shell flaw CVE-2026-114938 (CVSS 8.1), and Siemens lists no fix yet. Siemens says it is preparing fixes. Its advisory calls shutting down instances or disabling internet connectivity the most effective immediate measure.
title: Siemens: Java4Shell flaw affects all Industrial Edge Management Pro and Virtual versions, no fix yet

validation.note: Primary source: Siemens ProductCERT advisory SSA-272816, read in full.

review.note: source published day missing (added 2026-11-18); mitigation wording differed from source: now 'shut down instances or disable internet connectivity' as Siemens states, action names Siemens' advice
